about_the_game:
This is Your Extraction

The Fixers is a third-person cyberpunk extraction shooter where survival comes at a cost and power is earned through risk. Drop into high-threat Raids across a decaying cityscape. Loot rare tech, fight off AI and rival mercs, and extract before time runs out. Fail, and you lose everything that isn’t protected. Succeed, and you shape the city in your image.

Every run is a test. Every bullet is a choice. Welcome to Maverick City

Enter the Raid

A Raid is a high-stakes deployment into handcrafted urban warzones crawling with threats. You’re up against hostile AI, rival players, and the city itself. Loot what you can. Extract with your life. Or disappear into the static.

Mission Types

  • Eliminate targets

  • Recover prototype tech

  • Escort HVTs under pressure

  • Scout hostile territory

  • Upload dangerous payloads

Build Your Legacy

Every Raid ends in The Lobby, your persistent player hub. Here, you regroup, rearm, and plan your next run. Visit Fixers. Accept contracts. Customize your hideout. Explore squad apartments. Challenge friends to bowling, pool, or fistfights in neon-lit fight clubs.

This is your safe zone between the storms. Upgrade it. Own it. Make it yours.

Lobby Features

  • Trade gear with players

  • Buy upgrades from vendors

  • Prepare loadouts for your next Raid

Fixers Decide Your Fate

Fixers are your lifeline to the underground. Each one offers unique contracts, gear, and lore. Build loyalty to unlock faction secrets, legendary missions, and game-altering perks.

Choose Your Allegiance

  • O-Rin "Glitch Queen" Hagasaki: Smuggler of stolen corp tech

  • Patch: Surgical gatekeeper of The Dead Link

  • Sipher: Analog tactician from the Truebloods

  • Mother N: Cold strategist of mind-based warfare

Your reputation defines what doors open. Or what doors close behind you. 

One City. Four Factions. Endless Stories

The Fixers takes place in Maverick City, a fractured mega-urban sprawl ruled by cybernetic empires and resistance syndicates. Pick your alliances carefully.

Faction Highlights

  • H.I.//CORP: Chrome-drenched weapon lords obsessed with augmentation

  • N.U.K.E.: Mind hackers obsessed with neural domination

  • The Dead Link: Glitched-out insurgents armed with stolen tech

  • The Truebloods: Analog warriors who believe wires are poison

Each group has secrets. Some will hire you. Others will hunt you. All of them remember what you’ve done.

Not Everyone Comes Back

Victory in The Fixers is never guaranteed. With a modular risk system, every Gig can spiral into chaos. Extraction points are limited. Ammo is precious. Death resets your run unless your Vault is prepped.

Some mercs rise to the top. Others are just names on the wall.

So prep your loadout, sync into the Mindcloud, and take the shot.

Because in this city, survival isn’t the reward. It’s the price of entry.

* Depictions of illegal organized crime
* Occasional strong language
* Minimal, non-sexual nudity

name: The Fixers

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i7-4790
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 480 or or Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7700X or Intel Core i7-12700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT, GeForce RTX 3060 or Intel Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required

short_description: The Fixers is a third-person cyberpunk extraction shooter. Raid deadly city zones, loot rare tech, fight AI and rival mercs, and extract or lose it all. Upgrade your Hideout, take contracts from Fixers, and survive PvE or PvPvE runs to build your legacy.
